one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now answer whether a provider-backed pilot is structurally ready to advance from one governed evidence chain, without confusing readiness with live provider execution permission.
thirty_second_version_delta: v10.8 stopped missing required roles before Council execution; v10.9 bundles the provider pre-execution evidence chain into one operator readiness decision.
product_review_trigger: If an operator cannot tell whether provider pilot readiness is different from live provider execution permission, reopen release framing as a product issue.
not_proven: This delta proves release-level structural readiness framing only; it does not prove live provider execution, production safety, billing safety, semantic truth, or external adoption.
